input_domain_binding.accepted_domain: I-JSON (RFC 7493) as invoked by RFC 8785 section 3.1: no duplicate object property names; string data expressible as Unicode (lone surrogates terminate with error per section 3.2.2.2 Note); number data expressible as IEEE 754 binary64 (NaN and Infinity terminate with error per section 3.2.2.3 Note).
input_domain_binding.duplicate_name_policy: Out of domain; RFC 8785 section 3.1 mandates I-JSON formatting which forbids duplicate property names; no first-wins/last-wins merge is defined by the source. Duplicate detection must operate on names equal after escape resolution (e.g. "A" vs "\u0041" denote the same name).
